name: Featured Image Customizer – Custom Featured Images with Logos
author: Krasen Slavov

sections.description:
Featured Image Customizer helps you generate professional custom featured images instantly using 100+ brand logos and icons. No design skills required.

Transform your WordPress posts and pages with eye-catching featured images that combine popular brand logos with customizable backgrounds. Perfect for tech blogs, comparison posts, tutorial articles, and social media sharing.

Why Use Featured Image Customizer?

  • Instant Image Generation – Create featured images in seconds, not minutes
  • 100+ Brand Logos – Access popular social media, tech, and business logos
  • No External Tools – Everything works directly in WordPress
  • SEO-Friendly – Properly optimized images with thumbnails
  • Classic & Gutenberg – Works with both editors seamlessly
  • Multisite Compatible – Fully tested on WordPress multisite networks

How It Works

  1. Click New Featured Image button in the post editor
  2. Select two brand logos from 100+ available options
  3. Choose a conjunction word (e.g., “vs”, “and”, “+”)
  4. Pick your preferred background color
  5. Preview and set your custom featured image

All generated images follow WordPress standards, include proper thumbnails, and appear in your Media Library for future use.

Key Features

Brand Logo Library
Access 100+ popular brand logos including social media platforms, tech companies, productivity tools, and more. View all available logos

Customization Options
* Multiple background colors to match your brand
* Logo combinations with conjunction words
* Standard WordPress image format (800x600px)
* Automatic thumbnail generation

Editor Integration
* Works in Classic Editor featured image meta box
* Gutenberg Block Editor compatible
* Quick access from post/page edit screen

Media Management
* All images saved to Media Library
* Full-size and thumbnail versions generated
* Option to clear cached logo files
* Bandwidth-saving local storage

Current Settings

Available at Settings > Media:

  • Enable/disable for Posts
  • Enable/disable for Pages
  • Clear locally cached logo files

Technical Specifications

  • Canvas Size: 800x600px
  • Logo Size: 150x150px
  • Font: Fira Code (conjunction text)
  • Font Size: 64px
  • File Naming: Auto-generated from post slug

Perfect For

  • Tutorial and how-to articles
  • Product comparison posts
  • Tech reviews and roundups
  • Social media share images
  • Blog post thumbnails
  • Service vs service content

Coming Soon

We’re actively developing new features:

  • Additional layout templates beyond logo + logo
  • Custom post type support
  • WooCommerce integration
  • Dynamic advanced options
  • More brand logos
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Featured Image Customizer
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Start creating custom featured images in your posts

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/featured-image-customizer/
  3. Go to Plugins and activate Featured Image Customizer
  4. Configure settings at Settings > Media

After Installation

  1. Edit any post or page
  2. Look for the New Featured Image button in the featured image area
  3. Select your logos and background
  4. Generate and set your custom image
sections.faq:
Does this work with Gutenberg Block Editor?

Yes. Featured Image Customizer works perfectly with both the Classic Editor and Gutenberg Block Editor. The New Featured Image button appears in the featured image meta box on both editors.

Can I use this with custom post types?

Currently, the plugin supports Posts and Pages only. Custom post type and WooCommerce support is planned for future releases. You can enable/disable Posts and Pages individually in Settings > Media.

Are the brand logos stored on my server?

Brand logos are loaded from our API. To save bandwidth, frequently used logos are cached locally on your server. You can delete cached files anytime from Settings > Media without affecting previously generated featured images.

Does it work on WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Featured Image Customizer is fully tested and compatible with WordPress Multisite installations.

Will generated images appear in Media Library?

Absolutely. All custom featured images are created following WordPress standards, include all thumbnail sizes, and appear in your Media Library for reuse.

Can I request new brand logos?

Yes! Contact us through the Krasen Slavov website to request specific brand logos. We’re continuously expanding our logo library.

Can I customize the image size or layout?

Currently, images are generated at 800x600px with a fixed logo + conjunction + logo layout. Additional layouts and customization options will be available in future versions.

Is there a Pro version?

Not yet. We’re focusing on perfecting the free version first. A Pro version with advanced features may be released in the future.

Where can I get support?

Use the Support Forum for questions and issues. We typically respond within 24 hours. Feature requests are added to our roadmap for consideration.
